### ✨ New Features

* Add Slim QQ patch for QQ 9.3.75 ([fa5ebb2](https://github.com/LostPRC/qq-lite-patches/commit/fa5ebb254f7a44cc2e604aa1a5603fe265e726ff))

patches.name: Slim QQ
patches.description: Reproduces the QQ Lite build: removes game center / mini games, Super QQ Show (ZPlan, UE4, Filament), crash/monitoring native libraries and other bundled extras, together with their AndroidManifest components.

options.description: Game center, cloud games, mini games and game widgets.
ZPlan / Zootopia / CMShow 3D avatars with the UE4, Filament and Wwise engines.
Bugly, Matrix, RMonitor, Beacon, QIMEI and WeChat crash native libraries.
VIP ad guide, bundled plugin APKs, payment SDK archive and festival red-packet assets.
